explanation: The series is a geometric progression with first term 5 and common ratio 2: 5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 160. Each term doubles the previous, so the missing term is 20 x 2 = 40.

explanation_sections.punchline: A constant ratio of 2 runs through every pair - the series is a pure GP, not an AP.
explanation_sections.approach: Apply clues most-certain-first: check ratios: 10/5=2, 20/10=2, 80/40=2, 160/80=2. All equal 2, confirming GP with r=2. Missing term = 20 x 2 = 40.
explanation_sections.lesson: Always test ratios alongside differences; when ratios are constant, use GP formula, not AP.
explanation_sections.timing: 25-30 seconds. The confirming check is the ratio after the gap (80/40=2) which locks in 40.
